release_notes: Fixes a startup failure in 3.1.71 where the till closed with Failed to execute script because the Users screen was missing from the package. A signed-in Super Admin can void a receipt directly. Void requests can be opened, corrected, and returned. Audit records open with the details that were stored. A cashier can request a past-date sale, and a manager, admin, or Super Admin approves it once. Inventory search is by product name. Only an administrator can archive a product or deactivate staff.
